name: com.trustdecision.liveness.cw.api.ui.TDLivenessReadyActivity
description: For a TrustDecision face-liveness check, this screen shows selfie preparation tips and a start button before camera capture. If the SDK skips the tips page, it moves straight to camera capture.
disableEffect: The TrustDecision liveness flow cannot open this screen, so checks that use this flow will fail before camera capture.
